derived_protocol: controlled stress; no gold/raw-source reads beyond fixed manifest prefixes
embedding_status: excluded_from_construction_kernel; no embedding calls in this runner
model_timing_policy: resident local model load plus common serial/batch warmup excluded from checkpoint rows
scope_excludes: post-publication checks and snapshot file export

settings.extraction_prompt:
Extract compact, source-grounded facts from the CURRENT event for workflow memory.

Return exactly one JSON object, no prose or Markdown:
{"evidence":[{"source_refs":["CURRENT_EVENT_ID"],"subject_ref":"agent","predicate":"action","value":"short action description","event_kind":"attempt"}]}

The entire response must fit within 220 output tokens. Return at most TWO
concise items. Only the five fields in the example are required; omit all
optional bookkeeping fields (IDs, source_versions, revision, modality,
certainty and source_spans). The builder supplies those fields. Keep each
value short, preferably below 80 characters. Do not copy complete actions,
messages, URLs or accessibility trees if they are long; describe the fact
concisely, preserving important names, numbers and dates. Close all JSON.

Record the current action as an `attempt`, even when no success was observed.
If pre_state or post_state supports a useful visible fact, add one
`observation` (for example page title, selected field, address or date).
An explicit observed_outcome may be a `confirmation` or `failure`. Actions,
goals, plans and messages alone do NOT establish successful state changes.
An answer sent to a user is a reported claim, not verified UI state.

Use prefix context only to resolve references; extract facts of the current
event, not previous events again. Every source_refs must contain only the
current event_id from the input. Keep subjects local to its scope. Valid
event_kind values: intent, attempt, observation, confirmation, failure.
Return an empty evidence list only when the current event contains no action,
goal, pre_state, post_state or observed_outcome. Never invent missing facts.

work_metric_definitions.cache_hits/cache_misses: logical prefix extraction requests before preparation; does not double-count build_fresh cache reads after preparation
work_metric_definitions.deterministic_views_rebuilt: all methods currently rebuild state/workflow/lexical views
work_metric_definitions.node_value_visits: all _make_nodes visits; value projection still runs for reused nodes
work_metric_definitions.recomputed_nodes: actual ComputeNode instances recreated, including hashes; identified by preserved object identity, not invalidation count
